fields.title: Tighten the workspace lint table with suppression reasons, unwrap, leftover-macro, assertion-message and missing-docs lints
fields.description: Packages inheriting [workspace.lints] enable only cognitive_complexity, too_many_lines and fn_params_excessive_bools, while native Runledger denies unwrap_used, dbg_macro, todo and reasonless suppressions and native Runlimit warns on missing_docs. Add clippy::allow_attributes, clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason, clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::dbg_macro, clippy::todo, clippy::missing_assert_message and rust missing_docs at warning level, enforced by the existing -D warnings verification. Replace #[allow] with reasoned #[expect] where the lint fires in every compiled configuration; keep any configuration-dependent suppression explicit with a reason. Remove the now-redundant crate-local #![warn(missing_docs)] attributes.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Workspace lint inheritors pass all four Clippy configurations with the new lints; every remaining suppression states a reason; docs/testing.md lint contract and the docs/status.md row describe the table; bash scripts/verify.sh passes on 1.98.1 and the outcome is recorded here.
fields.close_reason: Merged in PR #80 (e94c591). Added allow_attributes_without_reason, unwrap_used, dbg_macro, todo, missing_assert_message and rust missing_docs to [workspace.lints]; omitted allow_attributes by decision so configuration-dependent suppressions stay reasoned allows. bash scripts/verify.sh passed on 1.98.1 (Linux). macOS Clippy unverified; crates/batter-core/tests/lifecycle.rs at 503 lines is a budget warning only.

comments.author: claude:8e9dd243-a809-4ec9-bfdb-9985b8e836dd@f29009df
comments.text: Implemented (uncommitted working tree, 161 files). [workspace.lints] adds rust missing_docs and clippy allow_attributes_without_reason, unwrap_used, dbg_macro, todo, missing_assert_message at warn; clippy::allow_attributes was dropped by user decision (runledger-style) because dead_code in shared test support varies per including crate. Root clippy.toml sets allow-unwrap-in-tests. Production: 93 batter-sqlx verification docs (privilege policy types moved to policy/privilege.rs with re-exports to keep policy.rs under its 800-line budget; public paths unchanged), 15 reference-service docs, build.rs crate docs, quota_service example now returns Result and propagates, runlimit http unwraps replaced (invariant expect; HeaderValue::from), 6 assertion messages, stable allows converted to reasoned expect (too_many_arguments x5, metrics-off dead_code/unused_variables). Kept reasoned allow: result_large_err (fires only on macOS) and large_enum_variant in atomic/fast.rs (208 bytes vs 200 threshold; macOS Instant size could flip it). Tests: 42 test roots gained //! docs; 78 test/bench roots carry reasoned crate-level allows for unwrap_used and missing_assert_message; unreachable_code (41) and length/complexity suppressions converted to reasoned expect; 12 stale too_many_lines suppressions removed; dead_code in shared support kept as reasoned allow. join_capture moved into startup_signals/scenario.rs to keep startup_signals.rs within its 800-line budget. Verification: bash scripts/verify.sh passed on Rust 1.98.1 (exit 0), after a first run failed only on the file budget (fixed); scripts matrix part rerun after a docs wording edit passed; workspace clippy with default and no-default features also clean. Limitations: Clippy on macOS not run; crates/batter-core/tests/lifecycle.rs now 503 lines (budget warning, not error). Tracker publish blocked by JOURNAL_FORK (machine identity used from two places).
